images.caption: U.S. Navy Hospital Corpsman 2nd Class Adam Martin, left, attached to the III Marine Expeditionary Force's Tactical Medical Simulations Center, watches a Vietnamese People's Navy medical officer insert a needle into a mannequin during a basic lifesaving course April 24, 2012, in Da Nang, Vietnam, during Vietnam Naval Exchange Activities (NEA) 2012. Vietnam NEA is an annual collaboration focusing on non-combat events and skills exchanges in areas such as navigation and maintenance. The event is intended to foster improved relationships between the navies of the United States and Vietnam. (DoD photo by Cpl. Patricia D. Lockhart, U.S. Marine Corps/Released)
images.alt: U.S. Navy Hospital Corpsman 2nd Class Adam Martin, left, attached to the III Marine Expeditionary Force's Tactical Medical Simulations Center, watches a Vietnamese People's Navy medical officer insert a needle into a mannequin during a basic lifesaving course April 24, 2012, in Da Nang, Vietnam, during Vietnam Naval Exchange Activities (NEA) 2012. Vietnam NEA is an annual collaboration focusing on non-combat events and skills exchanges in areas such as navigation and maintenance.
